title: Ya Rab Koi Masooma
body:
Ya rab koi massoma zindan mein na tanha ho
Paband na ho aahein rone pe na pehra ho
Thi jisko neend aati shabbir key seene per
Zinda dare zindan uskey like ek aza ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindan-o-se aati thi awaz sisakne ki
Jaise key Sakina ko har zindan ro raha ho
Takraye na wo kyu kar zindan ki diwarao se
Bhai se aur phuphi se jisjo juda kiya ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindan mein aye najafi yaad ayi Sakina ki
Dil rokey keh raha hai ab na ujala ho
